text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Did you see Air Groove?! Her
running
was spectacular!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Marvelous, you did so very marvelously!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (It all feels so far away.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove and the others... The cheers
from the
stands... everything.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I always knew it wouldn't be easy, but...
I didn't
realize just how far ahead of me
they are.)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That was an awesome race! Air Groove
and
Marvelous Sunday were absolute
standouts. They
completely stole the
show!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober ran her heart out too, but
she's not
quite ready to go toe-to-toe
with senior racers
just yet.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family was best back in
McQueen's
day. Remember when Palmer
tore up the track at
the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, I find myself
watching the rain
come down from inside
my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to get some work done, but my
mind keeps
wandering, and I can't make
any progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen, Mejiro Dober was
dead on
her feet, so I wasn't able to talk
to her much and
simply escorted her
back to her dorm.
choice_data_list: （ドーベル……大丈夫だったかな）
choice_data_list_en: (Dober... I hope she's doing okay.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to her dejected mood, I've been
putting off
any sort of discussion about
the race. But just as
I'm contemplating
when the best time to talk
would be, I
hear footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
... I guess I shouldn't be surprised you're
back to
work already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is it all right if I use your TV?
choice_data_list: ドーベル……！
choice_data_list_en: Dober...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright told me that a program about this
year's
classic racers is about to start.
choice_data_list: え、テレビ？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, TV?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They'll probably cover yesterday's Arima
Kinen
too. I figured I should give it a
watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like a good idea, and I relax a
little. The
results of the race aside,
Mejiro Dober has done
an excellent job
in her classic year.
choice_data_list: そうか……！
そっか……！
choice_data_list_en: I see...!
I see...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This program has to cover that fact, and
I'm sure
it'll help improve her mood!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that a yes? I'll turn it on, then.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Moving on... Didn't Dober's performance
at the
Japanese Oaks remind you of
Mejiro Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Dark Duchess! She sure was
something. I
still have the image of her
running etched in my
mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha—

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
We can't talk about the Arima Kinen
without
mentioning Mejiro Palmer and
her back-to-back
Grand Prix victories!
Her runaway style is the stuff
of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Bright win the Triple
Crown also
brought back memories of
Mejiro Ryan. You can't
help but want to
cheer for her, you know?
choice_data_list: （これは――）
choice_data_list_en: (This is—)

text_block_list.name: Commentator C
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. And we mustn't forget the
spring Tenno
Sho if we're talking about
the Mejiro family!
Mejiro McQueen was
so impressive in it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the segment continues, Legacies of the Mejiro Family flashes across the screen, and footage of past Mejiros' feats is played back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The commentators continue lauding the
bygone
Mejiros' achievements, and the
social media
comments at the bottom of
the screen do much
the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how the program ends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: なんだこれ……！
なにこれ……！
choice_data_list_en: What is this...!
What is this...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The words fly from my trembling lips
without me
realizing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Mejiro Dober have
done
fantastically throughout their
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet, no one was praising them for
their
accomplishments. It was as if they
were just there
to help highlight the
other racers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Let it go.
choice_data_list: どうして、こんな――！
choice_data_list_en: Why did it come to this—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I said let it go! To be honest, I knew this
would
happen...
choice_data_list: でも！
choice_data_list_en: But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday during the Arima Kinen, I
could tell
how intense the senior racers
were—and how
inadequate I was next to
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The people I admire—Ramonu, Ryan,
and so
many more—are on a level so
high, I can't even
comprehend it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was fine when all I was doing was
blindly
worshipping them. I was simply
proud and dazzled
by how brilliantly
Ryan and the others shone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought all I had to do was follow
directly in
their footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't until I started chasing after
them in
earnest that I realized how
crushingly steep the
trail they blazed is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the closer I get to their light, the
more I find
myself imprisoned in their
shadows!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...They're so far away.
choice_data_list: ドーベル……
choice_data_list_en: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I promised Bright that we'd forge new
legacies as
the next generation of
Mejiros, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize how unfathomably far I
would have
to go in order to reach that
light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm still so weak... so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: でも君は、立派に挑み続けた！
でも貴方は、立派に挑み続けたよ！
choice_data_list_en: Still, you valiantly kept up the challenge!
But you kept taking on the challenge admirably!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks up in surprise, and I lock eyes
with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: ずっとこうして、君を見てきた
ずっとこうして、貴方を見てきた
choice_data_list_en: I've been watching over you like this all along.
I've been watching over you like this all along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell her as many times as I need, but
Mejiro
Dober did an incredible job
during her classic
year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I haven't managed to stop
my
shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Despite knowing the real reason why I
shake, I'm
still scared. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard she was trembling or
how
dispirited she felt, she always rose
to the
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know better than anyone how brilliant
the mark
she's left on racing history is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know how much work she's put in over
the past
two years, trying to forge her
legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 他の誰にも、君にだって言わせない！
他の誰にも、貴方にだって言わせない！
choice_data_list_en: I won't let anyone say that—not even you!
I won't let anyone say that—not even you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how many times I have to say
it until
she believes me. I'll say it a
million times if I have
to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: “メジロドーベル”は、強いウマ娘だ
“メジロドーベル”は、強いウマ娘だよ
choice_data_list_en: 'Mejiro Dober' is a strong Umamusume.
'Mejiro Dober' is a strong Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ... All right, I'm mad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so mad and disappointed, Trainer! Hic... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pounding rain that falls on the turf
outside
seems to mirror the stream of
tears spilling down
Mejiro Dober's
cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know it's my job to wipe her tears, but I
can't
stop my own from falling. Tearfully,
we swear to
make a comeback from this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And before we know it, the rain stops.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't discussed our next goal,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the spring Tenno Sho,
and the
Takarazuka Kinen comprise the
conventional
path the best senior racers
take.
choice_data_list: 春シニア三冠路線の……！
choice_data_list_en: From the Spring Senior Triple Crown route...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I don't want to give up the fight.
And I'm
not going to abandon the
promise I made with
Bright. Not yet.
choice_data_list: でも……だからこそ、行くんだな
でも……だからこそ、行くんだね
choice_data_list_en: Still... that's precisely why you're going, isn't it?
Still... that's precisely why you're going, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We still have to forge new Mejiro
legacies
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is now the Osaka Hai!
We'll shoot
the flare signaling Mejiro
Dober's comeback right
there amid the
cherry trees at Hanshin!
